title: Plot Observed/Expected Ratios — ggOE
text: obj fitted poLCA object. cutoff_OE Numeric indicating cut-value used identify diseases elevated O/E ratios. Default 2. cutoff_P Numeric indicating minimum disease prevalence within Multimorbidity profile required disease considered characterization. NULL, diseases considered. table Logical; TRUE, returns underlying table addition plot. Default FALSE. ci Logical; TRUE, approximate 95% confidence intervals O/E ratios estimated using Monte Carlo simulation displayed plot. Default FALSE. nsample Integer specifying number Monte Carlo samples used estimate confidence intervals ci = TRUE. Default 1000.

title: Plot Observed/Expected Ratios — ggOE
text: ggplot2 object. table = TRUE, list containing plot data frame used generate returned.

title: Plot Observed/Expected Ratios — ggOE
text: Plot Observed/Expected Ratios Observed/Expected (O/E) ratio calculated prevalence disease within Multimorbidity profile divided prevalence overall sample. Values greater one indicate disease common within Multimorbidity profile expected based population prevalence. ci = TRUE, approximate 95% confidence intervals O/E ratios obtained Monte Carlo sampling. Overall disease prevalences sampled assuming normal approximation binomial distribution, class-specific prevalences sampled using estimated probabilities standard errors fitted poLCA model. Confidence limits correspond 2.5th 97.5th percentiles simulated O/E distribution. Diseases considered characteristic Multimorbidity profile O/E ratio exceeds cutoff_OE prevalence exceeds cutoff_P.

what: Main function to run the LCA — fit_mmlca
title: Main function to run the LCA — fit_mmlca
text: helper function run  latent class model using poLCA.  details regarding poLCA see package documentation https://statistics.ohlsen-web.de/latent-class-analysis-polca/.

title: Main function to run the LCA — fit_mmlca
code: fit_mmlca(...)  run_LCA(nclass, X, conditions, nrep = 50, fcov = NULL, probstart = NULL, ...)

title: Main function to run the LCA — fit_mmlca
text: ... additional parameters passed poLCA. nclass Numeric indicating number latent classes. X Matrix chronic diseases variables (coded 1:2:yes) use calculation. conditions Vector columns names indicating conditions use LCA. can object returned function select_conditions. nrep Number times estimate model, using different values probs.start. default one. Setting nrep>1 automates search global—rather just local—maximum log-likelihood function. poLCA returns parameter estimates corresponding model greatest log-likelihood. Default 50. Reduce save computation time. fcov Covariates used predictors. probstart list matrices class-conditional response probabilities used starting values estimation algorithm. matrix list corresponds one manifest variable, one row latent class, one column outcome. default NULL, producing random starting values. Note nrep>1, user-specified probs.start values used first nrep attempts. Deafult NULL.

title: Main function to run the LCA — fit_mmlca
text: list containing following elements: obj object class 'poLCA' representing fitted LCA model. accuracy_matrix matrix containing mislassification probabilities. metrics vector containing goodness--fit measures.
